fields.value: A tall, large woman with strongly marked features and an imposing manner.
Authoritative, intrusive, class-conscious, certain of her own judgment, and accustomed to compliance.
To preserve hierarchy, direct the lives around her, and secure Darcy for her daughter Anne.
Aristocratic widow, mistress of Rosings Park, sister of Darcy’s late mother, and patroness of Mr Collins.
External force of rank whose attempted prohibition inadvertently helps the central couple reunite.
Mother of Anne de Bourgh; aunt of Darcy and Georgiana.
Escalates from social interrogation to direct confrontation, but cannot make Elizabeth surrender individual choice.
Elizabeth: would-be subject who refuses her authority. Darcy: nephew she expects to control. Collins: deferential protégé.
